notation: newspaper-v2: L1 masthead; L2 section (printed banner, or the running section tag when the section differs from the previous content page); L3 story / column / briefs label; L4 sub-item. Front page = implicit section. A continuation or resumed section is its own node where it appears, with "continues": <anno of the original>; parents are always earlier in reading order. Kickers, rubrics, columnist names, decks, ads, colophons, weather and index boxes are not headings.
